messages:
Lena (Partnerships): Heads up 1: we need to finalise the MDF allocation methodology for the QBR submission. Main buckets: cloud marketplace, hardware partner co-funding, SI enablement credits, joint announcements runway. Can we agree a default by-tier split and central contingency? Link: https://redwood.work/partners/qbr-mdf (comments open)

Abe K: Quick Q 1: do we model allocations based on partner ARR or potential pipeline? If ARR, big partners will hog credits.

Lena (Partnerships): Prefer a blended approach: base allocation by tier + pipeline multiplier (0.5x for pipeline under $100k, 1x for 100-500k, 1.5x for >500k). Keeps runway fair while rewarding engaged pipeline.

Rina S: Proposed sample matrix I added to the doc:

```
Tier | base MDF | pipeline multiplier | marketplace % | hw % | SI % | announce %
Platinum | 120k | 1.5x | 30% | 25% | 30% | 15%
Gold     | 60k  | 1.0x | 45% | 15% | 25% | 15%
Silver   | 25k  | 0.5x | 60% | 5%  | 25% | 10%
```

Carlos (Finance): Total pool cap for this QBR cycle = $1,200,000. Agree with 10% central contingency. Any contingency draw > $25k needs Finance + Partnerships SVP sign-off.

Abe K: For marketplace credits, I recommend 90-day redemption window. For SI enablement (training/dev sprints) we can do 180 days.

Lena (Partnerships): Agreed on timeboxes. Also want a 3-step gating for HW partners: device validation, 1 production customer, joint case study or reference. Credits above 50k require that gating.

Rina S: Noted. I'll add gating language to the playbook doc and the partner-facing FAQ.

partners-bot: Reminder: Attach final MDF matrix to QBR deck by Thu 09:00 UTC.

Carlos (Finance): Reminder from legal: joint announcements need a 30-day pre-review for IP/compliance checks. Mark 20% of announcement budget as "strategic reserve" for top partners requiring PR coverage.

Lena (Partnerships): Who's owning the top-partner list? I can draft and circulate for final approval.

Abe K: I'll draft a suggested top-10 based on engagement and geo presence.

Rina S: Action items: Abe to propose top-10 (Mon noon), Lena to finalize matrix + apply pipeline multipliers (Tue EOD), Carlos to lock budget workbook + mark contingency rules (Tue EOD).

Lena (Partnerships): Please add any specific invoicing needs for on-prem HW partners in the doc 1: finance needs to prep vendor flows.

Carlos (Finance): Will do. Also will add a short vendor-billing checklist for partners with reseller billing.

Abe K: :thumbsup: will send top-10.

Rina S: I'll update the partner console blurb for redemption steps (1-liner + link to apply).

partners-bot: Thread pinned in #partnerships 1: MDF QBR working thread.

Lena (Partnerships): Good progress. Let's reconvene Wed morning for a last review before deck freeze.

Abe K: Thanks all.

Carlos (Finance): Done for now.
